content.title: Gen Z flocks to Pinterest as AI enhances shopping experience: CEO
content.description:
Pinterest (PINS) CEO Bill Ready sits down with Yahoo Finance executive editor Brian Sozzi at the 2025 Goldman Sachs Communacopia and Technology Conference to talk about the social media platform's growth within user demographics like Gen Z and the site's adoption and deployment of AI tools to enhance online shopping experiences.

For more CEO commentary from the 2025 Goldman Sachs Communacopia and Technology Conference, catch Brian Sozzi's full interviews with the chief executives from Verizon Communications (VZ) and Snowflake (SNOW).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
